notes: First real boot refused to start until eula.txt (written eula=false by MSC2, matching real Mojang behavior) was manually flipped to eula=true by the operator -- expected Mojang EULA gate, not a bug. Download URL and checksum were independently re-derived from Mojang's own version_manifest_v2.json/per-version metadata (the same lookup jar_provider.rs performs) and verified against the SHA-1 the on-disk jar actually hashes to; Mojang's manifest publishes SHA-1, not SHA-256, so checksum.algorithm here is sha1 to match what the provider actually publishes.
